review: Pure capabilities are standard-library code tested against RFC vectors. Library capabilities wrap the maintained library named per language; check its license and pin the version shown. Copy, then run the copied tests in the consuming project.

capabilities.title: TOTP / HOTP MFA codes
capabilities.summary: RFC 4226 HOTP and RFC 6238 TOTP (SHA-1/256/512), base32 secrets, otpauth:// enrollment URIs and constant-time verification with a skew window. Standard library only.

capabilities.title: SSO login request: OAuth 2.0 / OIDC authorization code + PKCE
capabilities.summary: RFC 7636 PKCE verifier/challenge, state and nonce, authorization URL builder, callback parsing with constant-time state check, and the token request body. Pair with oidc-token-verification to validate the returned ID token.

capabilities.title: MFA recovery (backup) codes
capabilities.summary: Unbiased Crockford-style recovery codes, normalization, HMAC-SHA256 hashing for storage and constant-time single-use lookup.

capabilities.title: Safe calculator and loan / interest math
capabilities.summary: Expression evaluator without eval (precedence, parentheses, unary minus, %, ^), loan payment, amortization schedule and compound interest rounded to cents.

capabilities.title: Form schema validation
capabilities.summary: Declarative server-side form validation (string, email, number, integer, boolean, date; required, length, range, pattern, enum) with stable error codes and unknown-field rejection.

capabilities.title: SEO files: sitemap.xml, robots.txt with AI-crawler rules, llms.txt
capabilities.summary: XML-escaped sitemap.xml, robots.txt with optional allow/disallow rules for AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, PerplexityBot and more) and llms.txt for AI answer engines. Standard library only, byte-exact output.

capabilities.title: Structured data: JSON-LD and meta / Open Graph tags
capabilities.summary: JSON-LD script tags escaped so they cannot break out of the element, plus title, description, canonical, Open Graph and Twitter card tags with HTML escaping.

capabilities.title: UTM campaign links: build, parse and strip tracking
capabilities.summary: Build campaign URLs with utm_* parameters (replacing existing ones, keeping fragments), parse UTM values, and strip tracking parameters (utm_*, gclid, fbclid, msclkid and more) from shared links.

capabilities.title: CSV read/write (RFC 4180) with formula-injection protection
capabilities.summary: Write RFC 4180 CSV with CRLF records and correct quoting, neutralizing cells that start with = + - @ so spreadsheets do not run them as formulas; parse quoted fields, embedded newlines and a BOM strictly. Standard library only.

capabilities.title: Money in integer minor units: parse, format, rates and allocation
capabilities.summary: ISO 4217 minor units without floating point: strict decimal parsing, plain formatting, tax or FX rates with banker's rounding, and largest-remainder allocation that always sums to the total. Standard library only.

capabilities.title: Signed, expiring pagination cursors (HMAC-SHA256)
capabilities.summary: Opaque base64url cursors carrying the last sort keys and an expiry, signed with HMAC-SHA256 and verified in constant time; errors distinguish malformed, bad signature and expired.

capabilities.title: Calendar invites: RFC 5545 .ics events
capabilities.summary: VCALENDAR/VEVENT output with UTC or all-day dates, TEXT escaping and 75-octet line folding that never splits UTF-8 characters, for email invites and add-to-calendar links.

capabilities.title: Sortable IDs: UUIDv7 and ULID
capabilities.summary: Time-ordered UUIDv7 (RFC 9562) and ULID generation from a CSPRNG and the clock, deterministic builders for tests, and timestamp extraction with strict parsing.

capabilities.title: Retry with exponential backoff and Retry-After
capabilities.summary: Full-jitter exponential backoff with a cap that never overflows, and Retry-After parsing (delay-seconds or IMF-fixdate) for HTTP 429 and 503 responses.

capabilities.title: Token-bucket rate limiter (pure, injectable clock)
capabilities.summary: Integer millitoken token bucket with capacity and refill rate, an injected clock and an exact retry-after for denied requests; keep the state in memory or in your store.

capabilities.title: Semantic versions and npm-style ranges
capabilities.summary: Strict SemVer 2.0.0 parsing and ordering (prerelease rules, build metadata ignored) and range matching with ^, ~, x-ranges, hyphen ranges and ||, desugared exactly like node-semver.

capabilities.title: Cron schedules: next run time
capabilities.summary: Five-field cron parsing (lists, ranges, steps, Sunday as 0 or 7) with the Vixie day-of-month/day-of-week rule, returning the next UTC run after a given time.

capabilities.title: WCAG color contrast
capabilities.summary: Relative luminance and contrast ratio per WCAG 2.x for hex colors, with AA and AAA pass checks for normal and large text.

capabilities.title: Geo distance, geohash and bounding boxes
capabilities.summary: Haversine distance in meters, geohash encode and decode with error bounds, and a bounding box around a point for radius queries in a database.

capabilities.title: Webhook signing and verification (HMAC-SHA256, t/v1 header)
capabilities.summary: Sign outgoing webhooks and verify incoming ones with Stripe-style t=...,v1=... headers: constant-time comparison, several v1 values for secret rotation, and a timestamp tolerance against replay.

capabilities.title: Check digits: Luhn, IBAN, GTIN/EAN/UPC and ISBN
capabilities.summary: Luhn validation and check-digit generation for card and account numbers, ISO 13616 IBAN mod-97 validation and formatting, GTIN-8/12/13/14 (EAN, UPC) and ISBN-10/13 validation with ISBN-10 to 13 conversion.

capabilities.title: Signed, expiring URLs (HMAC-SHA256)
capabilities.summary: Sign a path and query with an expiry and an HMAC-SHA256 signature for private downloads or one-click links, and verify in constant time with distinct malformed, bad signature and expired errors.

capabilities.title: Encoded polylines (Google polyline algorithm)
capabilities.summary: Encode and decode routes in the Google encoded polyline format at precision 5 or 6 (OSRM, Valhalla, Google Directions, Mapbox), with strict decoding.

capabilities.title: Web map tile math: slippy tiles, quadkeys, Web Mercator
capabilities.summary: Longitude/latitude to XYZ tile at a zoom, tile bounds, Bing quadkeys and EPSG:3857 meters for tile servers, caches, MapLibre, Leaflet and OpenLayers.

capabilities.title: Email address validation and normalization
capabilities.summary: The WHATWG HTML valid e-mail address rule with RFC length limits, and normalization that trims and lowercases the domain only. Syntax only: confirm ownership by sending a message.

capabilities.title: ISO 8601 durations
capabilities.summary: Strict parsing of ISO 8601 durations (P1DT2H30M, PT0.5S, P2W) into parts, exact milliseconds for day-and-time durations, and canonical formatting.

capabilities.title: Polygon geometry: point in polygon, area, centroid, simplification
capabilities.summary: Point-in-polygon with boundary handling, signed shoelace area and centroid, Douglas-Peucker line simplification and spherical polygon area in square meters (the Turf/Mapbox formula), for geofences and map shapes.

capabilities.title: Safe redirects (open-redirect guard)
capabilities.summary: Accept a returnTo or next parameter only when it is a same-site path or an absolute http(s) URL whose origin is on an allow-list; rejects protocol-relative, backslash, control-character, userinfo and javascript: tricks.

capabilities.title: IP addresses, CIDR ranges and SSRF guard
capabilities.summary: Strict IPv4/IPv6 parsing with RFC 5952 canonical text, CIDR membership, and a public-address check covering private, loopback, link-local (cloud metadata), CGNAT, multicast, documentation and IPv4-mapped/NAT64 ranges, for SSRF protection and allow-lists.

capabilities.title: HTTP Range requests (byte ranges, 206 and 416)
capabilities.summary: Parse a Range header against a file size into byte ranges, an unsatisfiable result (416 with Content-Range bytes */size) or none (serve the whole file), following RFC 9110, plus the Content-Range value.

capabilities.title: Content negotiation: Accept and Accept-Language
capabilities.summary: Choose the best response media type or language from Accept and Accept-Language headers with q-values, wildcards, most-specific matching and q=0 exclusions (RFC 9110, RFC 4647 basic filtering).

capabilities.title: ETags and conditional requests (304, 412)
capabilities.summary: Entity-tag parsing and strong/weak comparison, and the RFC 9110 evaluation order of If-Match, If-Unmodified-Since, If-None-Match and If-Modified-Since giving 200, 304 Not Modified or 412 Precondition Failed for caching and optimistic concurrency.

capabilities.title: Cookies: Set-Cookie and Cookie headers
capabilities.summary: Serialize Set-Cookie with Max-Age, Expires, Domain, Path, Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite and Partitioned, enforcing token/octet rules, SameSite=None and __Secure-/__Host- prefix requirements; parse Cookie headers into ordered pairs.

capabilities.title: URL normalization (RFC 3986)
capabilities.summary: Canonical http(s) URLs for caching, de-duplication and comparison: lowercase scheme and host, default ports removed, dot segments resolved, percent-encoding normalized, fragment dropped, IPv6 hosts canonicalized.

capabilities.title: String similarity: Levenshtein, Damerau, Jaro-Winkler
capabilities.summary: Edit distances (Levenshtein, optimal string alignment) and Jaro/Jaro-Winkler scores over Unicode code points, plus a normalized ratio, for fuzzy search, typo suggestions and duplicate detection.

capabilities.title: Recurring events: RFC 5545 RRULE expansion
capabilities.summary: Expand DAILY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY and YEARLY recurrence rules with INTERVAL, COUNT, UNTIL, BYDAY (including 2TU, -1FR and 20MO in the year), BYMONTHDAY and BYMONTH as filters for any frequency, in UTC, matching python-dateutil for every rule it accepts.

capabilities.title: Base32, Base58 and Base64url encoding
capabilities.summary: RFC 4648 base32 (standard and extended-hex alphabets, padded or not), Bitcoin-alphabet base58 and unpadded base64url, with strict decoders that reject bad characters, padding and non-canonical bits.

capabilities.title: vCard 4.0 contact export (.vcf)
capabilities.summary: RFC 6350 vCard 4.0 with name, organization, emails, phones, address, URLs and notes: text escaping, TYPE parameters, validation and 75-octet folding that never splits UTF-8, for "add to contacts" downloads and QR codes.

capabilities.title: Non-cryptographic hashing and jump consistent hashing
capabilities.summary: CRC-32 (IEEE), FNV-1a 32/64, MurmurHash3 x86_32 and Google jump consistent hash for checksums, sharding, cache keys and bucketing. Not for passwords, MACs or signatures.

capabilities.title: Feature flags: deterministic rollout and A/B variants
capabilities.summary: Evaluate a flag for a user with enable/disable, deny and allow lists, sticky percentage rollout (FNV-1a buckets out of 10,000) and weighted A/B variants, returning the reason and bucket for logging.

capabilities.title: Human-readable bytes, durations and relative times
capabilities.summary: Format and parse byte sizes in SI (kB) or IEC (KiB) units with integer rounding, compact durations ("1h 2m") and relative times ("3 minutes ago", "in 2 days").

capabilities.title: Line diff and unified diff output
capabilities.summary: Deterministic LCS line diff and unified diff in the GNU diff -u format that patch applies exactly (hunks, context, "No newline at end of file"), for change previews, audit logs and patches.

capabilities.title: Password policy checks (NIST SP 800-63B)
capabilities.summary: Length limits in code points, control-character, blocklist (breached passwords), user-context and repetitive/sequential checks with stable failure codes and no composition rules, as NIST SP 800-63B recommends.

capabilities.title: Text sanitizing and Trojan Source (bidi) detection
capabilities.summary: Normalize newlines, strip control, bidirectional-override and invisible characters from user or model text while keeping emoji joiners, truncate by code points, collapse whitespace, and report bidi controls (CVE-2021-42574).

capabilities.title: URL slugs: slugify titles and make them unique
capabilities.summary: Turn titles into URL-safe slugs (Latin accents transliterated by one fixed table, apostrophes joined, word-boundary truncation) and pick the first free slug-2, slug-3 ..., identically in every language.

capabilities.title: JSON Patch, JSON Pointer and merge patch (RFC 6902, 6901, 7396)
capabilities.summary: Apply RFC 6902 JSON Patch atomically, resolve RFC 6901 pointers, apply RFC 7396 merge patches and generate a deterministic patch (JSON diff) between two documents; includes a strict JSON parser where the language has none.

capabilities.title: OIDC ID token / JWT verification
capabilities.summary: Verify ID tokens and access-token JWTs with the maintained JOSE library of each language: JWKS keys, algorithm allow-list, issuer, audience, expiry and nonce.

rust.library: jsonwebtoken 11.1.0 (feature rust_crypto), ureq 3.4.2 for the JWKS fetch (MIT; MIT OR Apache-2.0)

capabilities.title: SAML 2.0 SSO (service provider)
capabilities.summary: Validate signed SAML responses and assertions with a maintained SAML library: signature, audience, recipient, time conditions and replay.

dependencies: pip install -r requirements.txt (xmlsec wheel bundles libxmlsec1)

dart.note: No maintained, permissively licensed Dart SAML library verifies XML signatures. Put an identity broker (Keycloak, Authentik or ZITADEL) in front of the SAML IdP and use the oidc-pkce and oidc-token-verification capabilities in Dart, or terminate SAML on a server with another language's implementation (for example go-saml-sso).

swift.note: No maintained, permissively licensed Swift SAML library verifies XML signatures. Put an identity broker (Keycloak, Authentik or ZITADEL) in front of the SAML IdP and use the oidc-pkce and oidc-token-verification capabilities in Swift, or terminate SAML on a server with another language's implementation (for example go-saml-sso).

capabilities.title: WebAuthn passkeys
capabilities.summary: Passkey registration and authentication ceremonies with a maintained WebAuthn server library: challenges, origin/RP ID checks, signature counters.

dart.note: pub.dev has no maintained WebAuthn relying-party (server) library. Verify ceremonies on a server using another language's implementation (for example typescript-webauthn-passkeys or go-webauthn-passkeys) or an identity broker; on the Flutter client use the passkeys package (BSD-3-Clause).

capabilities.title: Password hashing (Argon2id / bcrypt / scrypt)
capabilities.summary: Hash and verify passwords with Argon2id (or bcrypt/scrypt where Argon2 is unavailable), including parameter choice and rehash-on-login.

java.library: spring-security-crypto 7.1.1 + spring-core 7.0.9 + bcprov-jdk18on 1.86 (Apache-2.0; Apache-2.0; MIT (Bouncy Castle))

csharp.library: Geralt 4.4.0 (libsodium crypto_pwhash_str; pulls libsodium 1.0.22 native); BCrypt.Net-Next 4.2.1 (MIT (libsodium: ISC); MIT)

swift.library: Argon2 reference C library (P-H-C/phc-winner-argon2, pinned to commit f57e61e) (CC0-1.0 OR Apache-2.0)

capabilities.title: PDF form filling
capabilities.summary: Fill AcroForm fields in an existing PDF, optionally flatten, and read values back with a maintained, permissively licensed PDF library.

dependencies: pip install pypdf==6.20.0 (tests: pip install -r requirements-dev.txt)

dart.note: No maintained, permissively licensed pure-Dart library fills an existing AcroForm (package pdf only creates PDFs; pdfrx_engine has no form API). syncfusion_flutter_pdf can, but needs Flutter and a commercial/community license (license-review). Fill on a server with another language's implementation, e.g. python-pdf-form-filling.

capabilities.title: PDF parsing and text extraction
capabilities.summary: Extract page text and metadata from PDFs with a maintained library; notes on scanned PDFs (OCR) and layout limits.

dependencies: pip install pypdf==6.20.0 (tests: pip install -r requirements-dev.txt)

rust.library: pdf-extract 0.12.1 (re-exports lopdf 0.42) (MIT (declared in Cargo metadata; the crate and repository ship no LICENSE file, so keep the notice yourself: license-review))

dart.library: pdfrx_engine 0.6.1 (text, PDFium via FFI) + dart_pdf_reader 2.2.0 (Info dictionary) (MIT; Apache-2.0 (PDFium: BSD-style))

capabilities.title: Word (DOCX) document editing
capabilities.summary: Create, edit and read .docx documents (paragraphs, tables, replacing placeholders) with a maintained library.

go.library: github.com/gomutex/godocx v0.1.5 (create), github.com/lukasjarosch/go-docx v0.5.0 (placeholders); text via archive/zip + encoding/xml read-only scan (MIT; MIT)

dart.library: docx_creator 1.4.0 (MIT (package LICENSE; pub.dev shows "unknown", repository root is Apache-2.0: license-review))

swift.note: No maintained, permissively licensed Swift DOCX library works on Linux. Generate or fill the DOCX on a server with another language's implementation (for example python-docx-documents or csharp-docx-documents). On macOS only, NSAttributedString supports .officeOpenXML export (not verified here).

capabilities.title: Rich text / HTML sanitization
capabilities.summary: Sanitize user HTML from rich-text editors with an allow-list sanitizer before storage or rendering.

typescript.library: dompurify 3.4.16 on jsdom 30.1.2 (Apache-2.0 OR MPL-2.0; MIT)
